description: Will-based authority. Rare. Affects some Manifestors and Projectors.
decision_style: Decisions made from what you genuinely want and are willing to commit to. The question is 'what do I want?' and 'am I willing to do what it takes?' — not 'should I' or 'is this a good idea'.
time_to_decide: Can be immediate. The clarity comes from checking in with desire and will, not with logic or emotion.
career_application: Only commit to what you genuinely want and have the will to sustain. Don't make promises you're not willing to keep. Your word is a measure of your will — only speak it when you mean it completely.
common_mistake: Making decisions based on what seems logical or what others want, rather than what you genuinely desire.
